clips.title: The story
paras: Furl Scornbrow watches Durotar from the Razor Hill Watchtower. From its red stone bluffs, he keeps an eye on the plains and coast, guarding the settlement below.

The Razor Hill Watchtower rises above Razor Hill and the canyons around it. Thick timber and iron framing hold the outpost together. Durotar faces threats from Kul Tiras marines along the eastern shore, quilboar raiders across the scrublands, and Burning Blade cultists in nearby crags. From the ridgeline, a lookout can spot warbands, smoke signals, and incursions before they reach the settlement gates.
